_comment: Estimated prices in USD per million tokens, used for the dashboard's 'est.' cost figures. Edit freely; the file is re-read when it changes. A model is matched by the longest key contained in its name; 'opus' / 'sonnet' / 'haiku' are fallbacks for versions not listed. Cache reads and writes are priced as multiples of the input price. With a subscription login these numbers are only a rough guide.
